'''Raw Fish''' can be made from any caught fish at a [[Food Preparation Table]]. It can be cooked into '''Cooked Fish''' using a [[Cooking Station]]. [[Fish]] can be caught with a [[Fishing Rod]] using [[Fishing Bait]] or by picking up fish that have become stranded out of water. == Availability == {{Hatnote|This section is transcluded from [[Fish#Quality|Fish § Quality]].}} {{#lst:Fish|RawFishCrafting}} == Usage == === Crafting === ====For Raw Fish==== * {{Item link|Cooked Fish}} * {{Item link|Coal}}, if left on a Cooking station for too long * {{Item_link|Smoked Fish}} * {{Item_link|Fish Soup}} ====For Cooked fish==== * {{Item link|Fish Wraps}} * {{Item link|Sailor's Bounty}} {{FoodsNav}} [[Fr:Poisson_cru]] [[ru:Сырая рыба]] [[cs:Syrová ryba]]

'''Deer Meat''' is a basic food obtained by killing [[Deer]]. It can be cooked on a [[Cooking Station]] or [[Iron Cooking Station]] to obtain '''Cooked Deer Meat''', or [[Coal]] if overcooked. == Availability == {{drop table|title=Creature| {{drop row|item=Deer|0star=2|1star=4|2star=8|px=50}} }} == Usage == === Crafting === ==== For Deer Meat ==== * {{Item link|Cooked Deer Meat|nolink=1}} * {{Item link|Coal}}, if left on a Cooking Station for too long ==== For Cooked Deer Meat ==== * {{Item link|Deer Stew}} * {{Item link|Whole Roasted Meadow Boar}} Unlike most other foods made from meat, Deer Meat has to be cooked on a Cooking Station first to be crafted into other foods. {{FoodsNav}} [[Fr:Viande de cerf]] [[ru:Оленина]] [[uk:Оленяче м’ясо]] [[de:Hirschfleisch]] [[cs:Jelení maso]]

Mead= {{infobox item | description = The perfect drink for a day in the Plains. | id = MeadBugRepellent | type = Mead | source = [[Fermenter]] | usage = Drinking | weight = 1.0 | stack = 10 | teleport = Yes | materials = * [[Mead Base: Anti-Sting]] x1 | quantity = 6 | duration = 600 | effect = * Prevent [[Deathsquito]] attacks | cooldown = 600 }} |-| Mead base= {{infobox item | image = Mead base: Anti-sting.png | description = Needs to be fermented. | id = MeadBaseBugRepellent | type = Mead Base | source = [[Mead Ketill]] | usage = [[Fermenter]] | weight = 1.0 | stack = 1 | teleport = Yes | materials = * [[Cloudberries]] x10 * [[Grouper]] x3 * [[Fragrant Bundle]] x1 }}
'''Anti-sting concoction''' is a [[Plains]]-tier consumable item [[Fermenter|fermented]] from '''Mead base: Anti-sting'''. == Recipe == ''Mead base: Anti-sting'' is produced in a [[Mead Ketill]] with: * {{item link|Cloudberries|10}} * {{item link|Grouper|3}} * {{item link|Fragrant Bundle|1}} Six ''Anti-sting concoctions'' are produced by [[Fermenter|fermenting]] the mead base for two in-game [[Day and Night Cycle|days]]. == Effect == Consuming it grants protection against [[Deathsquito]]es. They will still approach the player, but will flee three to eight meters away instead of attacking. {{FoodsNav}} [[ru:Средство от смертожалов]] [[cs:Roztok proti štípancům]]

'''Lightfoot mead''' is a [[Mistlands]]-tier consumable item [[Fermenter|fermented]] from '''Mead base: Lightfoot'''. == Recipe == ''Mead base: Lightfoot'' is produced in a [[Mead Ketill]] with: * {{item link|Scale Hide|2}} * {{item link|Feathers|5}} * {{item link|Magecap|5}} Six ''Lightfoot meads'' are produced by [[Fermenter|fermenting]] the mead base for two in-game [[Day and Night Cycle|days]]. == Effect == Consuming it reduces jump stamina cost by 30% and increases jump height by 20% for 10 minutes. ==Trivia== * The stamina cost of jumps can be reduced to zero by combining ''Lightfoot mead'' (-30%), [[Feather Cape]] (-20%) and [[Forsaken power#Eikthyr Power|Eikthyr Forsaken power]] (-60%). {{FoodsNav}} [[ru:Медовуха Легкоступа]] [[cs:Lehkonohá medovina]]
